text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: This is a non-review paper focused on modeling nitrogen exports and evaluating basin management strategies for reducing coastal hypoxia. While it uses a land model (LM3-TAN) that includes land use and land cover change (LULCC) as a historical input, the primary research objective is not LULC prediction or simulation. The study projects future nitrate-N exports under scenarios of nitrogen input reductions and climates, but it does not project, simulate, or map future LULC. The core inclusion criteria of a primary focus on LULC prediction, implementation of ≥2 future LULC scenarios, and outputs of mapped LULC projections are not met. The paper is a biogeochemical modeling study assessing water quality management.)
